modules.name: Facility Check-in
modules.description: Lets residents check in at a shared facility with a tap in the app.

modules.name: Complaint Management
modules.description: Handles builder and society complaints, their assignment, status updates, routing and closure.

modules.name: Hall and Facility Booking
modules.description: Lets residents book halls and facilities, free of charge.

modules.name: Login
modules.description: Signs users in with an OTP sent by SMS.

requirements.title: Tap-based check-in at shared facilities
requirements.description: Check-in at a shared facility is a tap in the app, with no QR code or gate device.

requirements.title: Web Panel for builder complaint Assigned People
requirements.description: Assigned People for builder complaints use the Web Panel to handle them.

requirements.title: Status updates for society vendor complaints
requirements.description: A member with the Assign society complaints permission updates status on behalf of society vendors, who have no login.

requirements.title: Watchmen use the shared mobile app
requirements.description: Watchmen use the same mobile app as other users, with no separate gate app.

requirements.title: Complaint routing from categories and tags
requirements.description: Routing uses the complaint categories, responsibility tags and time limits supplied by Raghuvir.

requirements.title: OTP login by SMS
requirements.description: Login relies on an OTP sent through the SMS provider using an approved sender ID and template.

rules.title: One main user per flat
rules.description: Each flat has one main user, the owner or tenant who lives there.

rules.title: Closed complaints hidden from residents
rules.description: Closed complaints are fully hidden from residents, with no history screen.

rules.title: Hall and facility booking is free
rules.description: Hall and facility booking carries no payment in this phase; payment is deferred to Phase 2.
